source.stem:
The engine of a motor vehicle develops a large amount of power.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The driving force acting on the vehicle must be large.
The engine must have a very large volume.
The engine must transfer large amounts of energy each second.
The vehicle must be very fast.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Gravel with wider isolated pores lets water seep through faster than sand with narrower connected pores.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Clay is fastest, sand next, and gravel slowest.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The dark sand lets water seep through faster than the pale sand, despite their identical pore spaces.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: The material with the greatest total pore volume always lets water seep through fastest.

intelligence.enrichment: Water seeps faster through materials with wider, open, connected spaces between particles; gravel lets water pass fastest, sand slower, and clay slowest. Larger and better-connected spaces allow more water movement, which increases seepage rate and controls where water can move and be stored below the ground. The learner correctly applies this rule: Water seeps faster through materials with wider, open, connected spaces between particles; gravel lets water pass fastest, sand slower, and clay slowest. Clay lets water pass fastest because its particles are finest and the surface looks smooth.
